description: National Aquaculture Development Authority of Sri Lanka - Specific Pathogen free Post Larvae Production regulations - 2021
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made under the National Aquaculture Development Authority of Sri Lanka Act, establishing legal requirements for shrimp hatcheries regarding specific pathogen free operations.
